Port and infrastructure assets in Indonesia (PPGL) gain from government capex on downstream processing and export corridors, a policy tailwind independent of short-term volume swings.
sectors.ai: Buy selective Indonesian toll-road and port operators (CMNP, MITI) on tariff resilience and volume recovery, but avoid pure-play freight names (SAFE, PPGL) where the +25% spike is a one-off re-rating, not a trend. US logistics strength (CHRW, GXO) signals global trade stabilization, yet ID underperformance (-1.70%) warrants a WATCH stance—accumulate only on pullbacks to support levels, targeting 3-6 month horizon.
